links.outcome: Dosing calculation errors and sentinel dosing errors by LLM
links.effect: Baseline had 72.9% protocol adherence, 13.9% sentinel errors, incorrect final dose in 26.0%; refined prompt reduced sentinel errors to 1.0% and incorrect dose to 8.0%.
links.quote: TacroAI 2.0 demonstrated substantial improvements: protocol adherence increased from 72.9% (210/288) to 91.7% (264/288), protocol deviations decreased from 27.1% (78/288) to 8.3% (24/288), sentinel errors dropped from 13.9% (40/288) to 1.0% (3/288), and reproducibility improved from 77.3 to 86.7%.

links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM outputs across repeated identical inputs
links.effect: Identical outputs in 163/211 (77.3%) repeated cases at baseline and 183/211 (86.7%) with refined prompt; not perfectly reproducible.
links.quote: For TacroDose AI , 163 of 211 repeated cases (77.3%) produced identical outputs.

links.outcome: Protocol adherence and sentinel errors before vs after prompt refinement
links.effect: Refined structured prompt raised adherence from 72.9% to 91.7% and cut sentinel errors from 13.9% to 1.0% (p<0.001), and reproducibility 77.3% to 86.7%.
links.quote: Prompt refinement substantially reduced clinically significant errors, underscoring the value of structured guidance in LLM-based decision support.
